gwt.given: A DataConnectionManager's connection has RetryCount configured to 6, and the data provider's transient-error classifier reports a particular DbException as transient on every attempt.
gwt.when: A command execution on that connection throws that same DbException on the initial attempt and all 6 retries (7 attempts total), so the retry policy exhausts its configured retry count without a successful execution.
gwt.then: The call surfaces whatever exception the connection's current resilience policy (ResiliencePolicy.ExecuteAsync) throws straight to the caller — DataConnectionManager itself contains no code that intercepts, translates, catches-and-wraps, or constructs a RetryLimitExceededException or other wrapping exception around that failure.
